Class Piece

java.lang.Object
model.piece.Piece
public final class Piece extends Object
One game piece. A piece travels from Base along the shared track, then along the HomeStraight of its colour, and stops at Home (rule 6). It stores its location, direction, captures, Approach passes, movement effects and restriction. The methods that change a piece are public, but only Player should call them, so that the owner of the piece is always checked.
